item.text:
<linkedin_post>Google Research is studying whether cough recordings made with a smartphone microphone can help identify people who need further screening for tuberculosis. Its Health Acoustic Representations model, or HeAR, was trained on more than 300 million audio segments.

The approach could be useful in places where X-ray equipment is hard to reach. Research partners in Zambia and Ghana, along with a regional collaboration led by HELINA, are building the clinical evidence for cough-based triage.

A cough recording does not diagnose TB. Its potential role is to help health workers decide who should be referred for further testing.</linkedin_post>
